Welcome to the practical laboratory component of the Statistics course.

### Course Practicals
- 🔬 **[Lecture 1: Exploratory Data Analysis, Covariance & PCA](practicals/Step1_pca.qmd)**
- 📊 **[Lecture 2: Continuous Distributions, CLT & Confidence Intervals](practicals/Step2_distributions.qmd)**
- 🧪 **Lecture 3: Hypothesis Testing, Power & t-Tests** *(practicals/Step3_hypothesis_testing.qmd)*
- 📈 **Lecture 4: Correlation, Linear Regression & Multiplicity** *(Coming soon)*
- 🧠 **Lecture 5: Mixed Effects & Bring-Your-Own-Data Capstone** *(Coming soon)*

### Setup Instructions
1. Download the repository files to your computer.
2. Open `sissa-neuro-stats.Rproj` in RStudio.
3. Open `practicals/Step1_pca.qmd` and run the code cells alongside the lecture.
